research_objective: Investigate testable Cu-Ag catalyst hypotheses for electrochemical CO2-to-ethylene conversion.
revised_candidate: Pattern-resolved Ag-island Cu foil research plan

outcomes.next_decision_gate: Before electrolysis, register the primary pattern comparison, provisional matching tolerances, a meaningful effect threshold and uncertainty analysis. Provisionally require at least three independent electrodes per primary group and a 95% confidence interval whose lower bound exceeds a 20% relative difference in ethylene partial current for a positive pattern-effect decision; this is an operational threshold, not a predicted effect. Qualify product quantification and provisionally require 90–110% charge closure with uncertainty and missing products disclosed. After operation, require preserved spatial contrast and report surface and transport differences before interpreting the comparison. For a source-specific decision, require verified Ag-derived CO exposure at Cu and a validated isotope-method upper bound below the prespecified 10% ethylene-carbon threshold. Failure of a qualification gate triggers refinement or an inconclusive result, not a mechanistic conclusion.

limitations: Replay verifies saved records; it does not run agents.
Saved fingerprints verify file consistency, not scientific truth.
DFT findings apply only to the tested clean-slab model.
Research decisions require human scientific review.
